procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial assessment of only the exact permitted pins. Read packet, literal case, rubric, rules, compact method/addendum and adapter; verified input hashes/byte counts and read all five pinned production manifests without following their unlisted embedded paths. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are empty, so actual source opens and protected-layout reads are zero. Then actually opened and visually inspected all 15 exact PNGs via tools.view_image with detail original, emitted as images through functions.exec: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in that same three-view order. All fifteen completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, image judgment, any image score or diversity score. After that sequence, made actual first raw readings from the displayed native pixels in member/copy order and retained them in session memory. Date/hour spacing ambiguities in M1–M4 prompted one actual additional native re-open for each of those four members, resolving those entries while retaining every first raw reading. No other poster revisit, source substitution, generation/edit, peer record, producer self-inspection, spawned/resumed/forked critic, fabricated opening event or runtime session identity was used. PNG headers were separately checked against packet dimensions; all native PNGs have RGB color type 2. Ratings and diversity are this critic's own pixel judgments, not averages or maker intent.

content_form.location: large left plant and root cutaway
content_form.observation: A hand steadies a pot whose front reveals a large root network below leafy growth. The cutaway links the visible pleasure of foliage to the hidden living system that needs care, giving the care offer a specific visual counterpart.

hierarchy.location: right text column beside root illustration
hierarchy.observation: The dark plum title and promise lead to the explanation, then the large date and hours. The root illustration is a strong second entry point, while the market heading, venue, access, care, invitation and URL remain ordered along one alignment.

typography.observation: The fine serif Hangul has small strokes and wide internal rhythm at this scale. The four-line explanation and smaller access/care/invitation text require more effort than the large title and date, so the requested comfortable long-copy reading is not fully resolved.

typography.location: right numeric ranges and bottom URL
typography.observation: The date and hours read with adjoining en dashes, and the URL is intact without slash spacing. All twelve strings are observed once; serif display treatment is deliberate and the first raw readings require no revisit.

space.location: left foliage/roots and right text reserve
space.observation: The tall foliage fills the left field and is cropped at the top to emphasize living scale; roots anchor the lower part. The pink reserve keeps the right copy clear of the main plant, and group spacing separates explanation from visit details.

image_material.location: root cutaway, pot rim, hand and variegated leaves
image_material.observation: Delicate outlines and wash-like color coherently describe the leaf surfaces, pink pot and branching roots. The removed front of the pot is an intelligible illustrative cutaway rather than an accidental transparent object, and the hand has a clear supporting contact at the rim.

emotion_control.location: pink/purple plant scene and supporting hand
emotion_control.observation: Soft pink ground, plum type and variegated leaves create a quiet, curious mood. Revealing the roots adds attentive care to the attractive foliage instead of relying solely on pastel decoration.

ai_slop.observation: Roots connect to the plant base and spread through the soil area; stems and veins belong to readable leaves. The structural cutaway has a message-related purpose, and no unrelated motif or unexplained icon appears.

residuals: Exact first-read copy is intact, but small serif explanation/support text needs more comfortable usage-scale handling.
The root cutaway is a specific care concept; its distinctiveness does not compensate for the M1/M3 overlap elsewhere in the set.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.location: whole composition and relationship to M3
evidence.observation: M1's bright color photographs present a small pot, leaf surface and mature plant, but the three-photo half plus heavy sans title, bold promise and serif date stack closely matches the M3 system. This is a coherent sunny subdirection rather than enough separation to establish all five systems as clearly distinct.

evidence.location: watering diagonal and relationship to M4/M5
evidence.observation: Opaque brushwork, deep blue/cream/orange relationships and the diagonal hand/can/water/pot action form a distinct active-care scene. Its modeled painting and energetic direction differ from M4's flat printed silhouettes and M5's quiet pale cutaway; all still share the title/promise/explanation/date/support role stack.

evidence.location: photo strips and relationship to M1
evidence.observation: Monochrome root-work close-ups change activity and tone, and horizontal strips differ from M1's mosaic. Yet both use the same broad photographic split-field language, heavy sans title/promise and serif visit ranges. The care content is different, but this pair remains too close in its complete visual system for the full-five distinct-style requirement.

evidence.location: two-pot gestures and relationship to M2
evidence.observation: Yellow ground, dark-green flat leaves, orange hands, burgundy type and printed grain create an exuberant graphic identity. Touching a leaf and holding a pot are readable selection gestures, distinct from M2's modeled watering action despite a shared left text sequence.

evidence.location: left root cutaway and relationship to M2/M3
evidence.observation: Pale pink/plum relationships, delicate outlines/washes, serif Hangul and a single exposed root system create a calm, curious illustration. This differs from M2's opaque blue watering scene and M3's tightly cropped monochrome root photographs. It is a distinct member, while its addition does not resolve the M1/M3 system overlap.

residuals: Five single posters are present, with substantial content-grounded plant imagery in every member.

The shared reading route is acceptable in itself; the diversity shortfall concerns how closely M1 and M3 retain photographic-panel language, display/support type roles and overall image/text relationships after changes of color, photo subject, crop order and side.
The complete set has several clear directions but does not fully deliver five clearly distinct visual systems; the independent diversity judgment is 3.
Date/hour spacing mismatches in M1–M4 and usage-scale small-text concerns in M2/M5 are retained in their image records and cannot be averaged away.
